description: Website change monitor: watch public web pages (competitors, suppliers, policies, job and tender pages) and get every change, lines added and removed or a keyword appearing, by webhook (Slack, Discord, Zapier, Make, n8n) and RSS/JSON feed. Free for 3 pages. This tool checks one public page now (robots.txt obeyed) and returns the extracted page data and what changed since the last public check.

key.description: Optional Shiftmoor key (free or paid) for more checks a day

name: check_page
title: Shiftmoor: check a page now
